CT_INVALID_RESOURCE_CONSTANT: Invalid language resource or missing key.
CT_MYSQL_ER_DUP_ENTRY: The username or another entry is already registered in the system.
CT_MYSQL_FK: Invalid reference: the indicated doctor or patient does not exist.
CT_MYSQL_ROW_REFERENCED: Cannot delete: the record has associated data.
CT_AUTH_ROLE_REQUIRED: Access denied: you do not have the required role for this operation.
CT_AUTH_ACCOUNT_INACTIVE: Your account is deactivated. Contact the administrator.
CT_PASS_TOO_SHORT: Password must be at least 6 characters long.
CT_REQ_CREDENTIALS: Incomplete credentials. You must provide username and password.
CT_EDAD_POSITIVE: Age must be a number greater than zero.
CT_FECHA_FORMAT: Date must have a valid YYYY-MM-DD format.
CT_HORA_FORMAT: Time must have a valid HH:MM format.
CT_TIEMPO_POSITIVE: Estimated time must be a number greater than zero.
CT_TIEMPO_REAL_REQUIRED: Real attention time is required when marking the appointment as Attended.
CT_FECHA_NAC_FORMAT: Date of birth must have a valid YYYY-MM-DD format.
CT_FECHA_NAC_FUTURA: Date of birth cannot be in the future.
CT_EXP_POSITIVE: Years of experience must be a number greater than zero.
CT_TURNO_NO_DISPONIBLE: No appointment available: the doctor already has another appointment at that time considering the estimated duration and the safety margin between consultations.
CT_TURNO_FECHA_PASADA: You cannot book an appointment on a past date.
CT_TURNO_VENCIDO: The appointment has already expired and cannot be reactivated.
CT_TURNO_CANCEL_FORBIDDEN: The appointment does not exist, does not belong to you, or can no longer be cancelled.
CT_TURNO_NOT_FOUND: Appointment not found or you lack permission to modify it.
CT_DOCTOR_NO_PROFILE: Your user is not linked to any doctor.
CT_HISTORIA_SIN_ACCESO: You do not have access to this patient's clinical history.
CT_ADMIN_CANT_CHANGE_SELF: Operation denied: you cannot modify your own role.
CT_ADMIN_CANT_DEACTIVATE_SELF: Operation denied: you cannot deactivate your own account.
CT_ADMIN_USER_DEACTIVATED: User deactivated successfully. Their historical data is preserved.
